item.title: TuuL: Modulator Random
item.description: video upload by gotharman "A dual bandpass filter is modulated by a modulator. The modulator Level/Ripples (LevlMod) and the Curve then gets modulated be the modulators own step random source. Modulator Rate is then modulated by another modulator, just to make some space sounds :)" www.gotharman.dk

item.title: What is it about the Oberheim TEO-5?
item.description: video upload by Molten Music Technology "We've had the TEO-5 analogue synthesizer on show at the last couple of Synth Picnic events and it's consistently the synth people like the most.
